{{Quote|You think we're making this up?"<br />"Of course. You're running a classic Zeltron Shift-embarrass the spoilsport.|Han Solo and Jaina Solo|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>}}
A '''Zeltron Shift''' was a discussion tactic in which one party attempts to embarrass the other party.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible" />

In [[41 ABY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] thought her parents, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], were using this tactic against her.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible" />
